notes.title: SAMUZA IS GOING FREE TO PLAY
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

[h2]Starting March 2025 the game is going free to play.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799786/822554c6a4d418a6722d9c21ab891710c6016d31.jpg[/img]

[h2]Why the Change?[/h2]

Soon after release we developed a demo version which was intended to provide players with a good ideia of the game. Unfortunatelly due to the nature of the game at the time, in order to have the demo version playable without an internet connection, we had to remove a lot of features that make SAMUZA fun.
Since the game's release we have made a lot of changes and fixes to the base game, including an offline mode, which were not present in the demo version.
We have decided to remove the old demo version, and instead make the game available for free to everyone.


[h2]To those who bought the game[/h2]

SAMUZA is our first game as developers and we were really happy to see people having fun with it during the several live events. 
We want to thank everyone who bought the game for their support and kind words up until now. 
Before going free to play, we will add a few exclusive charaters and give them to everyone who played the game until then.


[h2]What changes[/h2]

Everyone will be able to play the game for free. That's it.
We will continue to update the game with small fixes and new content as we have been doing until now.

In SAMUZA, a big part of the experience is in the making and playing of new levels from the community. 
This change should bring more people into the game which, in turn, should result in more and interesting levels being created for everyone.

notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799786/54e282be55d44e4eaaf7418fb6a4d50ca627da17.png[/img]

[b]Happy Halloween![/b]

This update adds a new difficulty mode to the campaign and a new Halloween themed character.


[b]Campaign changes[/b]

- Small changes to the tutorial level
- 24 new levels
- Difficulty options added to the campaign level selection screen

The campaign can now be played in either "Easy" or "Hard" difficulties.
The Hard difficulty consists of the previously existing levels.
The new Easy difficulty consists of the 24 newly added levels. These offer a more relaxed experience to the game.
Playing in either difficulty allows you to proceed in the campaign. You can replay previously completed levels in either difficulty from the level selection screen.


[b]Endless and Versus[/b]

The new campaign levels were also added to these modes.


[b]Level Search[/b]

You can find all campaign levels using the level search screen.
They will have the names SAMUZA 1-2 to 5-5 followed with (Easy) or (Hard).
You can also easily find the campaign levels by using the [OFFICIAL] option on the [Search By] dropdown.

notes.title: OFFLINE Mode!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

With today's update you will also be able to play Samuza while not connected to the internet.

[b]Offline mode[/b]
We tried to make the online and offline experience as similar as possible for those playing on devices that are not necessarily always connected to the internet, such as laptops or the Steam Deck.
Some game features still require internet access in order to use, check below for more information.

[b]2P Story mode[/b]
A 2P story option has been added under the 2P menu. This will allow you to continue/play the story mode either in singleplay or with 2P.


[b]What can I not do while offline?[/b]
As mentioned above, some game modes require internet access in order to use. 
These are the Endless and Versus modes for singleplay and 2P. These modes use exclusively user-made levels which are not playable while offline, since the necessary level data cannot be obtained.
The level Search screen in singleplay and 2P is also not available for the same reason.
The character Shop where you get new skins with ingame currency is also not available while offline.
In the Creator mode, you will not be able to Upload levels to the server while in offline mode.
A warning screen will be shown if you try to acccess any online exclusive feature while offline.


[b]What can I do while offline?[/b]
If you start the game while not connected to the internet you should see a new confirmation screen. You will have the option to retry the login process or start the game in Offline mode.
Choosing to start in offline mode will disable some of the game features. While playing in offline mode, an [OFFLINE] text will be displayed on the top right corner in the main menu.
You will have access to the Story and Creator modes. 
Story progression and story item unlocks will carryover between online and offline modes.
Although you cannot access the character Shop, already obtained skins will still be available in the character Change screen.
In the Creator mode you will be able to start or load any levels in your saved data. Levels being worked on in the Creator mode are stored locally and will be available either in online or offline modes.


[b]For existing players[/b]
Adding a completely offline mode required a rework not only to some game systems, but also to the game's save data itself.
The game will try to convert your existing save data to the new format automatically. This will happen the first time you play the game(after the update) while connected to the internet.
If you update the game and immediatelly try to play without an internet connection, the game will not be able to convert your save data and an error message will be shown.
Once you have started the game with an internet connection and your save data has been converted, you should be able to play with and without an internet connection.
Let us know if you encounter any issues in this process.

notes.title: Achievements, Remote Play and More
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 
We released a big update for SAMUZA today!

Here are the changes on this version:
- Steam Achievements
- Remote Play Together
- Button Remapping
- Widescreen and Superwide Resolution support
- Climbing


[b]Steam Achievements[/b]
This update introduces steam achievements for all you collectors out there.
You should be able to get all the achievements by playing the game normally.
There are no secret achievements for now.


[b]Remote Play Together[/b]
If you own a copy of SAMUZA you will now be able to play with a friend online using Steam's [Remote Play Together] system.
For those new to Remote Play Together, this system allows you to play local multiplayer games online with friends. To do this, you first launch the game and then invite your friend to play the game together. We should have a guide on how to play SAMUZA with Remote Play Together soon.
SAMUZA now works the same way in local multiplayer and Remote Play Together. You can play with two players. Player 1 (or Host in Remote Play) can use mouse/keyboard or a gamepad. Player 2 will need to use a gamepad to control the second character.


[b]Button Remapping[/b]
You can now rebind the Keyboard keys and Gamepad buttons in the controls screen inside the game.
If you have two gamepads connected, the changes will be applied to both gamepads.
In case you have any issues with your gamepad not working, please check the Steam Input controller settings for SAMUZA and make sure you have the [Gamepad] layout selected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799786/f32d24ba0e35b0cbf2d31efe3a156b16f793477a.png[/img]


[b]Widescreen and Superwide Resolution support[/b]
We have added extra widescreen resolutions and added support for Superwide resolutions.
In the Video settings screen you can now choose from a list of 16:10, 16:9, 32:10 and 32:9 resolutions.


[b]Climbing[/b]
After falling and hitting it's head a lot, SAMUZA remembered he had arms and will now use them to try and climb the sides of road blocks, instead of falling.
This will happen automatically, as long as SAMUZA is in the air and you keep pressing the direction of the road block.

https://youtu.be/s2-E86vrbLc

notes.title: SAMUZA Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799786/ae0784b4d17bea325e9275beca2d93b583f52e59.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

we have just released the demo version of SAMUZA!

If you want to check if the game is right for you, the first 5 levels of the singleplayer story mode are now available to play in the demo.


Demo limitations:
While you can test a portion of the campaign, all account and community related features are only available in the full version.
These include playing user made levels, local multiplayer and the level creator.
